title: Staff Technical Writer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.


Okta is seeking a Staff Technical Writer to lead documentation for major product launches, spanning both developer.okta.com (APIs, SDKs, integration guides) and the help.okta.com (admin/product guides).



Reporting to the Manager of Technical Documentation, you'll quickly ramp up on the team’s guidelines and processes and set expectations with cross\-functional partners on documentation deliverables.

  


**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Work Mode:** Hybrid (minimum of 2 days onsite/week)


**Note:** Requires an in\-person meeting with the Hiring Manager at our Bengaluru office following the final rounds.



Onboarding requires in\-person travelling to our *Bengaluru office.*


**What you'll be doing**
------------------------


* Work closely with Engineering, Product Management, QA, Support, and members of the Information Development team.
* Prioritize documentation work across concurrent initiatives to meet release dates.
* Create end\-to\-end feature documentation for multiple engineering teams. These include developer content (API references and SDK/CLI/Terraform guides) and admin/product content (feature and configuration guides).
* Develop comprehensive product expertise through hands\-on engagement to ensure documentation accuracy and alignment with customer workflows.
* Become an expert in the Information Development team’s guidelines, processes, and tools.
* Identify scope for improvement and suggest enhancements, including the use of Generative AI tools to increase productivity.
* Analyze customer feedback before and after delivering documentation to enhance content depth, quality, and relevance.

**Minimum knowledge, skills, and abilities**
--------------------------------------------


* 7\+ years writing documentation for Cloud or Enterprise products.
* **Tools/Technologies**: Oxygen XML Author, VS Code, Acrolinx, Git/GitHub, Jira, and Confluence.

**Framework: DITA, Markdown, OpenAPI, and API publishing platforms.**


* **AI Tools**: Hands\-on experience with Generative AI tools to enhance documentation quality and workflow productivity.
* Security/IAM domain knowledge (Okta or similar IDaaS).
* Track record of leading the documentation efforts independently for a launch.
* Strong technical fluency to read code and API specs and validate content firsthand.
* Experience writing for Developers, such as SDK, CLI, or API reference guides.
* Comfortable prioritizing and negotiating scope or timelines with stakeholders.
* Self\-starter and a strong communicator (both verbal and written).
* Experience working with team members across different timezones.
* A team player who enjoys collaborating with different stakeholders.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, agile environment.

**Desired knowledge**
---------------------


* Familiarity with localization and translation best practices.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  


**Education**
-------------


* Bachelor, Diploma or Masters degree in Technical Communications, Information Systems, or a related technical field, and equivalent work experience, is required for this role.

title: Documentation Specialist
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**



At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:


**Purpose**



Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**



Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**



Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**



Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

  


**Role Description**



We are looking for a Senior Documentation Specialist to own the customer\-facing documentation experience for Amtech's ERP and MES products. You will be the person who turns complex manufacturing workflows — estimating a corrugated order, scheduling a corrugator run, tracking WIP through conversion, closing the loop to invoicing — into documentation our customers actually use and trust.



This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will write and maintain user guides, in\-application help, release notes, and how\-to content; you will also set the standards, style, and structure that all Amtech product documentation follows. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Support, and you will be expected to learn our customers' world — the plant floor, the order lifecycle, the way a packaging manufacturer actually operates.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Documentation ownership**


* Plan, write, edit, and maintain the full library of customer\-facing documentation for Amtech's ERP and MES products, including user guides, configuration and administration guides, quick\-reference materials, and in\-application help.
* Own the release notes process end to end — partner with Product and Engineering each release cycle to capture what changed, why it matters, and what customers need to do about it.
* Audit existing content on a regular cadence; retire what is stale, rewrite what is unclear, and close gaps that show up in support tickets and customer feedback.

**Standards and structure**


* Establish and enforce a documentation style guide, terminology standards, and content templates so that everything Amtech publishes reads as one voice.
* Define and improve the information architecture of the help center — how content is organized, searched, versioned, and navigated across product lines and releases.
* Administer and improve the documentation toolchain and publishing workflow; recommend improvements to tooling, single\-sourcing, and reuse.

**Collaboration and subject\-matter expertise**


* Partner with Product Managers, developers, QA, implementation consultants, and support engineers to gather source material, validate technical accuracy, and get ahead of upcoming releases.
* Use the product yourself. Build a working understanding of packaging manufacturing operations and of how Amtech customers configure and run the system in production.
* Participate in release readiness and go\-to\-market planning to ensure documentation ships alongside the software, not after it.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to document AI\-enabled capabilities as they ship, making new intelligence features understandable and trustworthy to customers.

**Quality and measurement**


* Define quality standards for documentation and review the work of other contributors — writers, product managers, and engineers who contribute content.
* Track documentation effectiveness using search analytics, page performance, support ticket deflection, and direct customer feedback; use that data to prioritize the roadmap.

**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required Qualification**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in technical writing, product documentation, or technical communications, with a substantial portion producing customer\-facing content for a software product.
* Demonstrated experience documenting enterprise software — ERP, MES, supply chain, or comparable operational systems.
* A portfolio of published documentation you can walk us through, showing how you explain complex, multi\-step workflows to a non\-technical operational audience.
* The ability to take an engineer's explanation of a feature and turn it into instructions a plant scheduler can follow on the first read — precise, plain, and logically sequenced, with no step assumed.
* A rigorous eye for editing: you cut what is unnecessary, catch inconsistent terminology, and hold a large content library to one standard.
* Proven experience owning documentation standards — style guides, templates, terminology, and information architecture — not just executing against someone else's.
* Hands\-on experience with a component content management or help\-authoring platform — MadCap Flare, Paligo, Heretto, Document360, Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or comparable — including publishing, versioning, and single\-sourcing across product lines.
* Proficiency with screen capture and image editing tools for clear, consistent visual documentation.
* Comfort working directly with software: navigating a complex application, reading a spec, testing a workflow, and validating your own instructions against the product.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, Information Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Direct experience documenting ERP and/or MES platforms, especially in a manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with packaging, corrugated, folding carton, label, or other discrete or process manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and business concepts such as specifications, routings, scheduling, WIP tracking, inventory, order\-to\-cash, and shop\-floor data collection.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows (Markdown, Git, static site generators) or structured authoring (DITA, XML).
* Experience producing video walkthroughs, product tours, or e\-learning content alongside written docs.
* Exposure to API or integration documentation.
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate drafting, editing, and content audits — with the judgment to know where human verification is non\-negotiable.
* Interest in structuring documentation for machine consumption as well as human readers, so content can reliably feed in\-product AI assistants and search.
* Experience supporting a global customer base, including localization or translation workflows.
* Background in a SaaS or hybrid on\-premise/cloud software environment with a regular release cadence.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**



Hybrid role based out of Amtech's Bengaluru office, with roughly three days per week on\-site, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support colleagues across our India and North America teams. Occasional travel for customer site visits, industry events, or company meetings.


**Why Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

* Create cuts, transitions, subtitles, text animations, graphics, motion and visual effects that add to the story

* Adapt videos across different formats, durations, aspect ratios and languages
* Work closely with writers, graphic designers, photographers, strategists and campaign teams
* Handle multiple edits and priorities without letting quality or attention to detail slip
* Deliver high quality work on tight deadlines

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1 to 4 years** of experience as a Video Editor, preferably in political campaigns, digital media, advertising, news or other high volume content environments
* Strong command of **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* Knowledge of **DaVinci Resolve** is a plus
* Strong understanding of **Reels, Shorts, YouTube and social first video**
* Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, music, typography and visual composition
* Ability to take raw footage and figure out **what the story actually is**
* Ability to work quickly in a fast moving, deadline heavy environment
* Strong command of **English, Hindi \& Kannada**, including the political and cultural context behind the content
* Comfortable making creative decisions independently and adapting to changing priorities

### **WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* You’ve edited **political campaigns, news or public facing content** before
* Strong motion graphics and animation skills
* You understand **internet culture, memes and emerging formats**
* You have a sharp eye for **colour, sound design and visual storytelling**

title: Property Documentation Executive
description:
Property Documentation Executive

**Company:** Zorba Estates  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience:** 0–4 Years  
**Qualification:** Any Degree  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**About Zorba Estates**

Zorba Estates is a Bengaluru\-based real estate company providing professional property solutions to **buyers, sellers, property owners, and investors**.

We support clients throughout the property transaction process, including **property documentation, client onboarding, document verification, coordination, legal support, and transaction follow\-ups**.

Our goal is to provide clients with a **smooth, transparent, and professional real estate experience** through proper documentation, timely communication, and effective coordination.

**Job Overview :**

We are looking for a **Property Documentation Executive** to manage property\-related documentation, client onboarding, document collection, legal coordination, client communication, and transaction follow\-ups.

The candidate will coordinate with **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal professionals, and internal teams** to ensure that all required documentation and transaction activities are completed accurately and on time.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
**Property Documentation**

* Prepare and assist in drafting **Sale Deeds, Agreements, and other property\-related documents**.
* Collect and organize property documents from owners, sellers, and buyers.
* Check documents for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Coordinate with the legal team for document review and corrections.
* Maintain proper physical and digital records of property documents.

**Client Onboarding**

* Handle onboarding of **buyers, sellers, and property owners**.
* Collect required client and property information.
* Verify that the required documents have been submitted.
* Explain documentation requirements and next steps to clients.
* Maintain updated client and property records.

**Client Communication**

* Communicate with clients through **phone calls, WhatsApp, and email**.
* Provide updates regarding documentation and transaction status.
* Respond to client queries and coordinate with the appropriate team.
* Send professional emails requesting documents, approvals, signatures, and other requirements.

**Buyer, Seller \& Owner Coordination**

* Coordinate between **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal teams, and internal teams**.
* Follow up for pending documents, signatures, approvals, and information.
* Coordinate document sharing and other transaction\-related activities.
* Ensure smooth communication between all parties.

**Legal Documentation Support**

* Assist with preliminary checking of property documents.
* Coordinate with legal professionals for **property document verification**.
* Identify missing information or documentation and escalate issues to the concerned team.
* Assist in preparing documents required for property transactions.

**Follow\-Up \& Record Management**

* Maintain regular follow\-ups with clients and stakeholders.
* Track pending documentation and transaction activities.
* Update CRM, Excel, or internal systems regularly.
* Maintain confidential and organized records of client and property documents.
* Ensure assigned documentation activities are completed within timelines.

**Requirements**

* Any Degree.
* 0–4 years of experience in **property documentation, real estate operations, documentation, CRM, administration, or client coordination**.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Word, MS Excel, Email, and CRM**.
* Ability to handle confidential documents professionally.
* Knowledge of property documentation and real estate transactions will be an advantage.

**Freshers with good communication, documentation, and coordination skills are welcome to apply.**

Key Skills

**Property Documentation \| Sale Deed Drafting \| Agreement Drafting \| Document Verification \| Client Onboarding \| Legal Coordination \| Client Communication \| Email Communication \| Follow\-Up \| CRM \| MS Excel \| Real Estate Operations**

Why Join Zorba Estates?

* Practical exposure to **real estate transactions and property documentation**.
* Opportunity to work with buyers, sellers, property owners, and legal professionals.
* Learn real estate documentation and transaction processes.
* Develop professional skills in client coordination and operations.
* Career growth opportunities within Zorba Estates.

**Apply Now**

If you are **detail\-oriented, organized, good at communication and follow\-ups**, and interested in building a career in real estate documentation, apply for the **Property Documentation Executive** position at Zorba Estates.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
